reason: COMPLEX. What I noticed first was the pocket-sized sachet that tears open with one hand, because I always leave pills at home and live out of my tote. I would try one box, since the 3 forms sound more complete, but only because the sachet solves my forgetting problem.
objection: $29.99 is double what I paid for Toplux 8 forms in a flash sale, and that bottle lasts 3 months. I am paying a lot for the packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A first-box price around $19.99 or a flash-sale discount, or a small trial pack so I can test it before paying full price.
